As a Ship-s Event Coordinator, you will be the creative force behind unforgettable experiences at sea. From intimate gatherings to large-scale productions, you will curate, organize, and execute engaging events that enhance the guest experience. Your passion for entertainment, meticulous planning, and ability to bring people together will ensure that every event runs smoothly and exceeds expectations.

Your expertise in event planning will directly contribute to the success of our onboard entertainment and guest satisfaction. By working closely with different departments, you will transform ideas into reality, ensuring seamless execution from concept to completion. Guest Engagement - A passion for creating engaging and memorable experiences for international guests.
Multitasking & Organization - Exceptional time management skills to juggle multiple events and responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
### **Your Essentials** ###
The following qualifications are essential for success in this role:
proven experience in event planning, hospitality, or entertainment.

Fluency in English and at least one other European language.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Experience working in a multicultural team and engaging with international guests.

AMBOSS ist der Copilot für den medizinischen Alltag. Unser Team vereint Fürsorge, innovative Ideen und modernste KI-basierte Medizintechnologie.
